result: If I could change the world in one way, it would be to eradicate global poverty and ensure equitable access to basic necessities such as healthcare, education, and nutrition for all individuals. Poverty is a multifaceted issue that perpetuates cycles of disadvantage, health issues, and limited opportunities. By addressing poverty at its root, we could foster a more inclusive, healthy, and prosperous world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential. This change would require concerted efforts from governments, non-profit organizations, businesses, and individuals to work together, invest in the vulnerable, and implement sustainable solutions to lift people out of poverty.
